Name: Attached Document ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the record. Supply for existing records only. You cannot supply this ID for new records.

Name: Country Name
Description: The name of the country for the document type, such as Canada or United States. Only supply when the document type is country specific.

Name: Data Type Code
Description: The attachment type. Specify FILE, TEXT, or WEB_PAGE.

Name: Document Code
Description: The document code related to the attachment.

Name: Document Type
Description: The document type related to the attachment.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person this document record is for.

Name: Title
Description: The title of the attachment.

Name: Document Records ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the document record this attachment is for.

Name: Description
Description: A description for the attachment.

Name: Document ID
Description: The document management document ID for the attachment.

Name: Document Type ID
Description: The document type ID related to the attachment.

Name: File
Description: Specify the file name and place the file with that name in the a subfolder of the compressed HCM Data Loader file. The subfolder must be named BlobFiles.

Name: File Name
Description: The name of the attachment file.

Name: Mime Type
Description: The mime type for the attachment.

Name: Person ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the person this document record attachment is for.

Name: URL
Description: Specify the URL if the attachment is of type URL.

Name: URL or Text or File Name
Description: URL, Text or File Name for the attachment. Holds the URL in case the DataTypeCode is WEB_PAGE, or Text in case the DataTypeCode is TEXT or File Name in case the DataTypeCode is FILE.

Name: Version Number
Description: The document management version number for the attachment.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
